This 2019 Ford F-150 Raptor is far from your average truck. Built with a serious suspension and wheel/tire setup while keeping the engine nearly stock, this Raptor has the aggressive stance and off-road capability these trucks were made for. CARFAX reports NO accidents or damage reported.

Under the hood is Ford’s High-Output 3.5L Twin-Turbo EcoBoost V6 paired with the 10-speed automatic transmission. The engine remains stock aside from a K&N cold air intake, while the transmission has been flashed for improved shifting characteristics.
BUILD & UPGRADES:

• 37” Nitto Recon Grappler Tires
• 17” Genuine KMC Beadlock Wheels
• 3” Geiser Progressive Overload Front Springs
• Deaver Rear Leaf Springs
• Suspension Rebuilt Approximately One Year Ago
• K&N Cold Air Intake
• 10-Speed Transmission Flash/Tune for Improved Shifting
• Upgraded Carbon Fiber Steering Wheel
• Full Upgraded Audio System
• Upgraded Door Speakers
• Dual 8” Subwoofers Mounted Under the Rear Seats

The combination of 37-inch Nittos, true beadlocks, Geiser front springs, and Deaver rear leaf springs gives this Raptor an aggressive presence while significantly upgrading its off-road setup. Add in the upgraded interior audio system and carbon fiber steering wheel, and you have a Raptor that stands out both inside and out.
Zero Accidents or Damage Reported
I’d definitely advertise the 37s, true KMC beadlocks, Geiser/Deaver suspension, and rebuilt suspension near the top of the listing—those are some of the strongest selling points on this truck.

vehicles.name: 2006 Lamborghini Gallardo SE
description: 2006 Lamborghini Gallardo SE - branded title

This 2006 Lamborghini Gallardo SE is a serious head-turner and a special example of Lamborghini’s iconic naturally aspirated V10 era. Finished in an unmistakable bright Lamborghini verde Ithaca, this Gallardo has the exotic presence you expect from the brand, made even more aggressive by the bronze Forgiato wheels, large rear wing, and matching green brake calipers.

Inside, the black leather cabin features green contrast stitching throughout, Lamborghini crest detailing, and extensive carbon-fiber trim across the steering wheel and center console. The combination of black leather, carbon fiber, and green stitching ties perfectly into the exterior and gives the interior a truly custom exotic feel.

Behind the cabin sits Lamborghini’s legendary 5.0L naturally aspirated V10, paired with the E-Gear automated manual transmission and Lamborghini’s all-wheel-drive system. The exposed engine bay puts the V10 on display and is one of the highlights of the car.

The Gallardo SE combines the raw sound and character of Lamborghini’s early V10 platform with a more distinctive appearance than a standard Gallardo. Between the vibrant green paint, coordinated interior stitching, carbon-fiber details, V10 engine, and aggressive wheel setup, this is the kind of Lamborghini that gets attention everywhere it goes.

vehicles.name: 2015 Toyota Camry Hybrid
description: 2015 Toyota Camry Hybrid XLE,ONE OWNER,clean title

Clean, comfortable, and super fuel-efficient sedan with a smooth hybrid drive and premium XLE features. This Camry Hybrid delivers excellent gas mileage (around 40+ MPG combined) while still offering a quiet, responsive ride and the long-term reliability Toyota is known for.

Equipped with a 2.5L hybrid engine paired to an automatic eCVT transmission, this XLE model comes fully loaded with leather interior, heated front seats, power driver and passenger seats, and a power sunroof. It also features a touchscreen infotainment system with Bluetooth, navigation, and a premium sound system for a great driving experience.

Enjoy convenience and safety with a backup camera, smart key with push-button start, dual-zone automatic climate control, cruise control, and steering wheel-mounted controls. A perfect daily driver that blends comfort, technology, and efficiency in one dependable package.

vehicles.name: 2015 Toyota Corolla
description: 2015 Toyota Corolla S Plus, Clean Title

Sharp, sporty, and fuel efficient, this Corolla S Plus is the perfect daily driver with Toyota’s legendary reliability and low maintenance costs. Powered by a dependable 1.8L 4-cylinder engine with automatic transmission, this Corolla delivers a smooth ride and excellent gas mileage while still giving you sporty styling and comfort. Loaded with features including backup camera, Bluetooth hands-free and audio, touchscreen display, steering wheel controls, cruise control, alloy wheels, fog lights, premium sport interior, power windows and locks, cold A/C, and more. Clean inside and out with plenty of trunk space and seating for the whole family. A great commuter, first car, or reliable long-term vehicle.
